test_inputs.explanation: Values were taken from the agent's navigated URLs. The base URL http://dockerized-magento.local and admin frontname 'admin' appear in every admin URL. The agent visited order view URL with order_id 204 (also later visited order_id 521); 204 is chosen as the primary order_id. verify is set to true to perform post-submit checks, and wait_seconds is set to 5 to allow pages to load.
